Genetic studies of Jews.evidence: Passage presents multiple studies, methods, and caveats (e.g., 'leading to an underestimation of the Levantine component') in an even, academic tone without endorsing a single conclusion.

Autosomal DNA evidence supports the historical narrative of Jewish populations originating from the ancient Levant, with genetic diversity shaped by migrations, admixture, and isolation over millennia.
